title: Mechanical Design Engineer, Electromechanical Systems, Energy Products
description:
**What to Expect**

Tesla Energy is looking for a highly skilled, motivated engineer to own the mechanical design of key subsystems in our next-generation Energy products. You will work on high-voltage distribution, power conversion hardware, and the products that power Tesla Supercharger, industrial Energy and data center applications. The role requires strong engineering fundamentals, a passion for pushing the boundaries of technology, and the tenacity to make your designs succeed. Tesla operates on compressed timelines, so self-motivation, discipline, and resilience are critical. We aim to recruit the most talented engineers to accelerate the world's transition to sustainable energy.

The Energy mechanical design team is a diverse group of engineers building world-class power hardware. We make major system architecture decisions and own detailed design, simulation, and hands-on mechanical development, from early ideation through mass production. Our work spans high-voltage (HV) distribution systems, PCBA packaging, and electromechanical device design for medium-voltage (MV) subsystems, data center applications, and next-generation power conversion. Few teams at Tesla work on core power distribution technology and also on products that everyday people use. If you are mission-driven, enthusiastic, and love hands-on engineering, this team is for you.

 **What You'll Do**

* Design and model mechanical components and assemblies, including sheet metal, structural metals, plastics, environmental sealing, and fasteners
* Perform design analysis, including structural and thermal FEA, design for assembly (DFA), design for manufacturing (DFM), and design for test (DFT)
* Partner with cross-functional teams to refine specifications and meet performance, aesthetic, schedule, cost, reliability, and quality targets
* Collaborate with thermal, systems, electrical, sourcing, manufacturing, and reliability teams to take designs from prototype to mass production

description: ABOUT THE TEAM Our Robotics team is focused on unlocking general-purpose robotics and advancing toward AGI-level intelligence in dynamic, real-world environments. This role combines compute architecture, high-speed digital design, onboard power electronics, and compact HDI PCB development. We’re looking for a self-driven engineer who takes ownership from concept through deployment.
